plan.contract: public/tasks.mjs exports pure functions over task records {id:string,title:string,completed:boolean}; inputs are never mutated and list functions return new arrays. addTask(tasks,title,id) appends {id,title,completed:false}. completeTask(tasks,id) marks only that task completed, keeping every id and the order. visibleTasks(tasks,options={}) keeps source order; options.query filters titles by case-insensitive substring. IDs are assigned once and never replaced. public/index.html is a complete document with a <title>, a viewport meta tag and <script type="module" src="app.mjs">. public/app.mjs imports from ./tasks.mjs and calls addTask, completeTask and visibleTasks to render a keyboard-accessible list with an add form, a search input and completion controls; public/style.css styles it.

tasks.title: Task behavior
tasks.instructions: Implement addTask, completeTask and visibleTasks in public/tasks.mjs exactly as the shared contract states. Record the stable-identity decision with context_publish. Do not edit interface files; report contract discrepancies through peer_message.

tasks.title: Task board interface
tasks.instructions: Implement the interface in public/index.html, public/app.mjs and public/style.css against the shared contract. Start immediately: import from ./tasks.mjs without waiting for the behavior capture, and report contract discrepancies through peer_message. Do not edit public/tasks.mjs.

plan.contract: The existing task board contract is unchanged. public/tasks.mjs also exports taskLink(task), returning '#task=' + encodeURIComponent(task.id), and resolveTaskLink(tasks,fragment), returning the task whose link equals fragment or null; it keeps working after tasks are completed or reordered. public/app.mjs renders each task's link and highlights the task named by location.hash on load and on hashchange.

tasks.title: Bookmarkable task links
tasks.instructions: Add taskLink and resolveTaskLink to public/tasks.mjs and wire task links into the interface as the shared contract states. Open and cite the prior design choice from your context before editing.

plan.contract: The existing task board and bookmark contract is unchanged. visibleTasks(tasks,options) also accepts options.status: 'all' (default), 'active' (not completed) or 'completed'. It combines with options.query and keeps source order. Title sorting belongs to the concurrent run.

tasks.title: Status filtering
tasks.instructions: Add options.status to visibleTasks in public/tasks.mjs and a status control in the interface as the shared contract states. Do not add sorting.

plan.contract: The existing task board and bookmark contract is unchanged. visibleTasks(tasks,options) also accepts options.sort: 'title-asc' or 'title-desc', comparing titles case-insensitively; omitted sort keeps source order. It combines with options.query. Status filtering belongs to the concurrent run.

tasks.title: Title sorting
tasks.instructions: Add options.sort to visibleTasks in public/tasks.mjs and a sort control in the interface as the shared contract states. Do not add status filtering.
